subject: Acme RAG eval — post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>, Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme RAG eval — post-call recap & next steps

Thanks again for a great conversation today — appreciate the context on your knowledge base size and the primary KPI (grounding rate on customer support articles). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same playbook: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce support deflection false positives by improving grounding (precision and recall over KB docs).
- Data: ~250k doc chunks (mostly HTML/FAQ + product guides), some PDFs.
- Throughput requirement for PoC: 100 concurrent queries, 300 qps peak during business hours.

Redwood recommendation (short list)
- Retrieval: hybrid (BM25 for recall + dense DPR-style embeddings for precision). Start with BM25 + DPR dense retriever against your S3-backed corpus (we can index into a Vector DB if you prefer managed).
- Reranker: cross-encoder reranker for best grounding precision for QA flows (we can benchmark bi-encoder + lightweight reranker if latency is a hard constraint).
- Models: candidate families to evaluate: redwood-3-rapid (production latency friendly), redwood-7-accurate (higher F1), open-7b-q4 (cost-effective baseline). We'll provide a model recommendation matrix.
- Prompt sets & evals: we propose a 500-query seed evaluation (provided prompt set attached) + automated grounding metrics (precision@k, grounding rate, hallucination score).

Attached: acme_prompt_set_v2.csv (seed queries) and acme_initial_benchmarks.pdf (sample benchmark format).

Proposed next steps
1) You confirm approval to run a 1-week eval on Redwood Dedicated/demo cluster (we can use sandbox vectors on your S3 bucket or index into a managed vector DB).
2) We (Redwood) will run the eval: 500 queries x 3 model+retriever combos, collect grounding metrics and example failure cases.
3) Follow-up review next Wednesday to pick final model/reranker and discuss rollout plan.

Quick ask: are you available for a 30-min alignment call on Wednesday 2026-06-24 (10:00–10:30 PT)? If not, propose two other times.

Thanks — I’ll loop Rafael into technical planning once you give the go-ahead.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: acme_prompt_set_v2.csv (csv, 500 rows), acme_initial_benchmarks.pdf (sample report)

From: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@acmecorp.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme RAG eval — post-call recap & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifying q's before we greenlight the eval:

1) Data retention: for the PoC, will any customer content be stored on Redwood-managed systems? We need to confirm retention windows and ability to purge.
2) Retrieval layer: you mentioned S3-backed corpus vs managed vector DB — what does Redwood recommend for lowest-friction setup for our team?
3) Reranker: curious on typical latency impact of cross-encoder rerankers at 100 concurrent queries — should we be expecting a significant hit vs a cheaper bi-encoder pipeline?

We have a procurement loop that will want a rough cost estimate for a 1-week eval and a follow-on 30-day pilot if the results look good. Can you provide a back-of-envelope?

Appreciate it — if Rafael can jump in on technical bits that’d be great.

—Jordan
Jordan Matthews
Head of Conversational AI, Acme Corp
jordan.matthews@acmecorp.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@acmecorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme RAG eval — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Jordan/Priya — Rafael here (solutions engineering). Quick answers and more detail:

1) Data retention & storage
- For a standard PoC we can run in your VPC / S3 (customer-managed) so we do not retain any customer documents on Redwood-managed storage. If you prefer Redwood-managed indexing, default retention is 30 days and we provide purge APIs and audit logs. We can also sign an addendum for a shorter retention window.

2) Retrieval options and recommendation
- Lowest-friction: index your S3 corpus into our managed vector index (we do the ingestion) — minimal ops. If you need full control, we can provide ingestion scripts to produce an index you host (Weaviate/Pinecone/FAISS on your infra).
- Technical recommendation for grounding-heavy support use cases: hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense) tends to maximize recall while keeping precision high on long-tail docs. We often start with BM25 tuning (k1, b) + DPR embeddings (128–768 dims depending on model) for hit candidates, then rerank with a cross-encoder.

3) Reranker latency tradeoffs
- Cross-encoder provides the best precision@k but is ~3–5x slower vs a bi-encoder + lightweight reranker for the same batch size (depends on model size). For 100 concurrent queries we recommend batching and an async rerank pipeline — we can benchmark: cross-encoder on redwood-3-rapid and redwood-7-accurate shows median additional latency of ~120–250ms per query in our recent tests. If 99th percentile latency is critical, bi-encoder + cheap reranker is a reasonable path.

4) Cost/back-of-envelope for 1-week eval + 30-day pilot
- 1-week eval (500 queries x 3 model combos, dedicated sandbox nodes): ~$2,500–$5,000 (depends on chosen models and reranker).
- 30-day pilot (full traffic, 100 concurrent qps peak): ~$8k–$20k depending on model mix and storage/ingestion choices.

Attached: redwood_model_recommendations.xlsx with recommended model+quant profiles and expected token costs for the PoC.

Next steps
- If you approve, we will: (a) schedule ingestion (we'll need a short IAM role for S3 access or a zipped export), (b) run the eval and provide a results dashboard with grounding metrics + failure case snippets, (c) review together to pick model/reranker.

I can run a quick latency/throughput benchmark on our side if you send a small sample. Happy to jump on a call Wednesday 6/24 or propose other times.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_model_recommendations.xlsx (model matrix, cost estimates)
